# Read in and process data
```{r}
inventory <- readxl::read_xlsx("FileInventoryUpdatesRyan.xlsx")

meta <- asdf[[]]
meta$barcode <- colnames(asdf)
df.samples <- as.data.frame(table(asdf$orig.ident))

adt.assay <- GetAssayData(asdf, assay = "ADT")
saveRDS(adt.assay, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/adt.assay.rds")

asdf@assays$ADT <- NULL
Idents(asdf) <- asdf$orig.ident

#saveRDS(asdf, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.rds")
asdf <- R2easygene::update_genes(Seurat_obj = asdf, select_assay = "RNA", return_seurat = T, min.cells = 3, min.features = 100)

colnames(asdf@assays$RNA@layers$counts) <- colnames(asdf)
rownames(asdf@assays$RNA@layers$counts) <- rownames(asdf)

meta <- merge(meta, inventory[,1:14], by.x = "orig.ident", by.y = "Sample")

barcodes <- meta$barcode
rownames(meta) <- barcodes

asdf[[]] <- meta

asdf.new <- UpdateSeuratObject(asdf)
asdf <- asdf.new

VlnPlot(asdf, features = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0, y.max = 20)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "percent.rb", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "nCount_RNA", pt.size = 0, y.max = 30000)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "nFeature_RNA", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "HBB", pt.size = 0, y.max = 500)
table(asdf$db.class)

###############################################################################
saveRDS(asdf, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.unfiltered.rds")
```

```{r}
###############################################################################
final.all <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/ctcl.new.final.rds")
final.all$barcodes.match <- colnames(final.all)
asdf$celltype.new.study <- final.all$cell_type

asdf <- subset(asdf, percent.rb < 55 & db.class == "singlet")

s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
cell.cycle <- c(s.genes,g2m.genes)
tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJC]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ig_genes <- grep("^IG[JHKL][VDJC]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ribo <- grep("^RP[SL]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
mito <- grep("^MT-", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
hemoglobin <- grep("^HB[AB]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)

bad_genes <- c(cell.cycle, tcr_genes, ig_genes, ribo, mito, hemoglobin, "XIST", "MALAT1")

asdf <- NormalizeData(asdf)
s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
asdf <- CellCycleScoring(asdf, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = F)
asdf$cc.dif <- asdf$S.Score - asdf$G2M.Score
asdf$cc.total <- asdf$S.Score + asdf$G2M.Score
#asdf$celltype <- asdf.final.after.xgboost$celltype

asdf <- FindVariableFeatures(asdf, nfeatures = 3000, layer = "data")
vf <- VariableFeatures(asdf)
vf.ss <- setdiff(vf, bad_genes)
```

```{r}
hgnc.table <- HGNChelper::hgnc.table
```

```{r}
# NK-like phentoype
t.cells <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/t.cells.final.rds")

genes <- c("KIR3DL1", "KIR2DL4", "KIR2DL3", "TNFRSF4", "TNFSF9", "FCER1G",
           "GZMM", "GNLY", "TNFRSF18", "GZMB", "IFNG", "ZEB2",  "NCR1", "FOS",
           "KIR3DL2", "FOSL2", "FOSB", "SIGLEC7", "BHLHE40", "NCR2", "TBX21", "TNFRSF9", 
           "IL15", "NLRP7", "NKG7", "IL18", "HLA-DQA1", 
           "MYB", "SELL", "LEF1", "TCF7", "IL7R")
bulk <- AggregateExpression(object = t.cells, group.by = c("orig.ident", "final.clones"), return.seurat = T, features = genes)

mat <- bulk@assays$RNA@layers$data

annotation_col <- data.frame("final.clones" = bulk$final.clones)

mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
mat[is.nan(mat)] <- 0
colnames(mat) <- colnames(bulk)
rownames(mat) <- rownames(bulk)
pheatmap::pheatmap(mat, annotation_col = annotation_col, show_colnames = F, show_rownames = T, scale = "none", cluster_rows = T)
```

```{r}
library(SeuratData)
DefaultAssay(asdf) <- "RNA"
asdf.ss <- subset(asdf, barcode %in% colnames(asdf@assays$sketch))
DefaultAssay(asdf.ss) <- "RNA"

available_data <- AvailableData()

ref.sca <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/skin_cell_atlas_SO.rds")

InstallData("pbmcref", force.reinstall = T)
#pbmcref <- LoadData("pbmcref")
AzimuthObj <- RunAzimuth(asdf.ss, reference ="pbmcref")
asdf$pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l1 <- AzimuthObj$predicted.celltype.l1
asdf$pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l2 <- AzimuthObj$predicted.celltype.l2
asdf$pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l3 <- AzimuthObj$predicted.celltype.l3

InstallData("bonemarrowref", force.reinstall = T)
#pbmcsca <- LoadData("bonemarrowref")
AzimuthObj <- RunAzimuth(asdf.ss, reference = "bonemarrowref")
asdf$pred.azimuth.bonemarrowref.l1 <- AzimuthObj$predicted.celltype.l1
asdf$pred.azimuth.bonemarrowref.l2 <- AzimuthObj$predicted.celltype.l2

HPCA <- HumanPrimaryCellAtlasData()
Monaco <- MonacoImmuneData()

mat <- asdf.ss@assays$RNA@layers$data
rownames(mat) <- rownames(asdf.ss@assays$RNA)
colnames(mat) <- colnames(asdf.ss@assays$RNA)

res <- SingleR(mat, ref=HPCA, labels=HPCA$label.fine, num.threads = 16)
df <- data.frame("pred.hpca" = res$labels)
rownames(df) <- rownames(res)
asdf <- AddMetaData(asdf, df)

res <- SingleR(mat, ref=Monaco, labels=Monaco$label.fine, num.threads = 16)
df <- data.frame("pred.monaco" = res$labels)
rownames(df) <- rownames(res)
asdf <- AddMetaData(asdf, df)

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(reference = ref.sca, query = asdf.ss, dims = 1:30,
      reference.reduction = "harmony")
predictions <- TransferData(anchorset = anchors, refdata = ref.sca$final_clustering, dims = 1:30)
asdf.ss$pred.sca <- predictions$predicted.id
DimPlot(asdf.ss, group.by = "pred.sca", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)+NoLegend()
asdf$pred.sca <- asdf.ss$pred.sca
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "pred.sca", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)+NoLegend()

DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "orig.ident", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "cloneType", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l1", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l2", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "pred.azimuth.pbmcref.l3", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "pred.azimuth.bonemarrowref.l1", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "pred.azimuth.bonemarrowref.l2", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "pred.hpca", raster = F, pt.size = .1, alpha = .1, label = T)+NoLegend()+NoLegend()
```

```{r}
#asdf <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.final.rds")
table(asdf$celltype)
t.cells <- subset(asdf, celltype == "T_Cells")
df.t.sample.hyper <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$hyper))
df.t.sample.hyper.ss <- subset(df.t.sample.hyper, hyper > 3)

#check <- subset(t.cells, CTgene %in% c("NA.NA.NA_NA.NA.NA.NA","NA_NA.NA.NA.NA","NA.NA.NA_NA"))
#df.missing.ctaa <- as.data.frame(table(check$CTaa))
#t.cells$CTgene[t.cells$orig.ident %in% unique(check$orig.ident)] <- t.cells$CTaa[t.cells$orig.ident %in% unique(check$orig.ident)]

# Split CTgene into alpha and beta chains
t.cells$split.alpha <- stringr::str_split(t.cells$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 1]
t.cells$split.beta <- stringr::str_split(t.cells$CTaa, "_", simplify = TRUE)[, 2]

table(t.cells$hyper)

list <- rownames(df.t.sample.hyper.ss)
list <- setdiff(list, paste0("S", 161:170))
# Initialize storage for new clone assignments
ss <- subset(t.cells, hyper == "hyper" & orig.ident %in% list)
  
split.alpha <- ss$split.alpha
names(split.alpha) <- ss$barcode
split.alpha <- split.alpha[split.alpha != "" & !is.na(split.alpha) & split.alpha != "NA"]
  
split.beta <- ss$split.beta
names(split.beta) <- ss$barcode
split.beta <- split.beta[split.beta != "" & !is.na(split.beta) & split.beta != "NA"]

table(ss$orig.ident)

#save.new.clones <- character()

t.cells$shared.alpha <- NA
t.cells$shared.beta <- NA

for (i in seq_along(list)) {
  # Subset the cells by orig.ident
  idx <- t.cells$orig.ident == list[i]
  
  sample <- list[i]
  
  current_alpha <- t.cells$split.alpha[idx]
  current_beta <- t.cells$split.beta[idx]
  
  alpha.top <- as.data.frame(table(t.cells$split.alpha[idx]))
  beta.top <- as.data.frame(table(t.cells$split.beta[idx]))

  alpha.top <- subset(alpha.top, Var1 != "NA" & Var1 != "")
  beta.top <- subset(beta.top, Var1 != "NA" & Var1 != "")
  
  alpha.top$pct <- alpha.top$Freq/sum(alpha.top$Freq)*100
  beta.top$pct <- beta.top$Freq/sum(beta.top$Freq)*100

  alpha.top.aa <- as.character(alpha.top$Var1[which.max(alpha.top$Freq)])
  beta.top.aa <- as.character(beta.top$Var1[which.max(beta.top$Freq)])
  
  t.cells$shared.alpha[idx] <- current_alpha %in% alpha.top.aa
  t.cells$shared.beta[idx] <- current_beta %in% beta.top.aa
}

t.cells$shared.clone <- ifelse(t.cells$shared.alpha | t.cells$shared.beta, "Shared", "Unique")

table(t.cells$cloneType, t.cells$shared.clone)
table(ss$orig.ident)
```

```{r}
################################################################################

combine_matrices_list <- function(matrices_list) {
  
  # Step 1: Get all unique column names from all matrices
  all_colnames <- Reduce(union, lapply(matrices_list, colnames))
  
  # Step 2: Align each matrix to the full set of column names, filling missing columns with NA
  aligned_matrices <- lapply(matrices_list, function(mat) {
    missing_cols <- setdiff(all_colnames, colnames(mat))
    
    # Add missing columns filled with NAs
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      mat <- cbind(mat, matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = length(missing_cols),
                               dimnames = list(NULL, missing_cols)))
    }
    
    # Reorder columns to match all_colnames
    mat <- mat[, all_colnames, drop = FALSE]
    return(mat)
  })
  
  # Step 3: Combine all aligned matrices by row
  combined_matrix <- do.call(rbind, aligned_matrices)
  
  return(combined_matrix)
}
scale_matrix <- function(mat) {
  min_val <- min(mat)  # Find the minimum value
  max_val <- max(mat)  # Find the maximum value
  scaled_mat <- (mat - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)  # Apply the scaling formula
  return(scaled_mat)
}

asdf.ss <- subset(asdf, agg %in% df.agg$Var1)

asdf.agg <- AggregateExpression(asdf.ss, return.seurat = T, group.by = c("orig.ident", "celltype.malig"))
rm(asdf.ss)

df.counts <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(asdf$celltype.malig, asdf$orig.ident))

for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  ss.agg <- subset(asdf.agg, celltype.malig == tmp)
  mat.ss.agg <- ss.agg@assays$RNA@layers$data
  ss.agg <- FindVariableFeatures(ss.agg, nfeatures = 2000)
  features <- VariableFeatures(ss.agg)
  features <- setdiff(features, bad_genes)

  colnames(mat.ss.agg) <- colnames(ss.agg)
  rownames(mat.ss.agg) <- rownames(ss.agg)

  mat.ss.agg <- mat.ss.agg[rowSums(mat.ss.agg) >10,]
  mat.ss.agg <- mat.ss.agg[rownames(mat.ss.agg) %in% features,]
  mat.ss.agg.scale <- mat.ss.agg

  rownames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- paste0(tmp, "_", rownames(mat.ss.agg.scale))

  colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- str_extract(colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale), "^[^_]+")
  colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale) <- str_extract(colnames(mat.ss.agg.scale), "^[^_]+")
  
  mat.ss.agg.scale <- apply(mat.ss.agg.scale, 2, function(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
  all.matrices[[i]] <- mat.ss.agg.scale
}

summary_stats <- df.compare %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(Value),
    lower_ci = mean(Value) - qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * sd(Value) / sqrt(n()),
    upper_ci = mean(Value) + qt(0.975, df = n() - 1) * sd(Value) / sqrt(n())
  )

  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +  # Add raw data points
  geom_errorbar(data = summary_stats, aes(x = Category, y = mean_value, ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), width = 0.2) +  # Add CI bars
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "Values") +
```
```{r}
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tumor" = "blue", "pp" = "red"))
```

```{r}
# Convert labels to factor for classification
labels <- factor(pseudobulk_data$labels)
  
# Prepare the training data
pseudobulk_matrix <- as.data.frame(t(pseudobulk_data$pseudobulk_matrix))
  
# Split the data into training and test sets
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(pseudobulk_matrix)), size = 0.8 * nrow(pseudobulk_matrix))
train_data <- pseudobulk_matrix[train_idx, ]
test_data <- pseudobulk_matrix[-train_idx, ]
train_labels <- labels[train_idx]
test_labels <- labels[-train_idx]
  
# Train a random forest model
rf_model <- randomForest(x = train_data, y = train_labels, ntree = 100)
  
# Evaluate the model
predictions <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
accuracy <- sum(predictions == test_labels) / length(test_labels)
  
cat("Model Accuracy:", accuracy, "\n")
  
return(rf_model)
```
